answer: Every new identity pays a sybil tax of 500 POA, burned at entry. A raven cloning itself a hundred times still pays a hundred taxes: 100 fakes cost 50,000 POA against 150 POA each per epoch, so breaking even takes 333 epochs, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its full reward. Audits sample recent joins and echo a higher tax when clones cluster. The rate peaks at the zenith of a cloning wave and falls when clean, keeping entry cheap.
